question: Does the cycle-002 xy ridge clear the same 20 px support line on split seed 1?
claim: The same Ridge(alpha=1) from stored float32 z to (x, y), with the only change being episode-split seed 1, has held-out frame-level MAE below 20 px on both coordinates, and each MAE is strictly below the train-mean constant predictor.
falsifier: Kill if either held-out coordinate MAE is at least 40 px. Any other computed result that misses the support line weakens. Inconclusive only if the MAE cannot be computed.
assumptions: x and y are info['block_pose'][0] and [1] in the same units as the oracle 15 px gate
z is the stored float32 latent and has dimension 192
the split procedure matches probe_theta.episode_split except that the Generator seed is 1
MAE is the unweighted mean of absolute error over test frames, not over episodes
seed 1 test episodes are the frozen list in this file, and exactly 10 of those 50 episodes are also in the seed-0 test set

seed0_regression.on_fail: abort before the seed-1 xy fit and do not write the observation

degenerate_check: Support requires disjoint episodes within the seed-1 split, features equal to stored float32 z, the frozen test-episode list, both test-frame MAEs below 20 px, and each of those MAEs strictly below the train-mean constant predictor. A test-episode intersection of 40 or more with seed 0 is not a second sample and aborts the fit.

next_action.deepen: Stress the same xy ridge on the Xeon by scoring episode-level MAE on seeds 0 and 1. Write that falsifier before the rescore. Do not add a model class. Do not start B6. Do not use a 4090.
next_action.pivot: The seed-1 reproduction missed the support line. Restate one xy claim before any refit. Do not start B6 in that revision. Ledger row 002 stays.
next_action.kill: Archive the reproducible xy-ridge claim. Ledger row 002 stays as the seed-0 measurement. The next cycle may frame B6 only, on the Xeon.
next_action.escalate: Stop. Do not rent a GPU.
